external.description: The Lakers’ sale appears to be getting closer. The Buss family dispute is getting nastier. Mark Walter and prospective buyer Josh Kushner have agreed to all remaining terms of a sale valuing the franchise at $12.5 billion, according to ESPN’s Ramona Shelburne⁠. The two met Thursday to finalize the terms and are expected to sign the agreement soon. It would then go to the NBA for review. Kushner has also made clear that he has raised the money needed to complete his end of the transaction, Shelburne reports. That follows public questions about whether he had secured enough funding.
